claim: Neonatal inflammation is common and has lasting consequences for adult health.

claim: Lipopolysaccharide-induced inflammation at postnatal day four induced lasting impairments in two distinct pathways to adult respiratory plasticity in male and female rats.

claim: One mechanistic pathway to plasticity was restored by acute, adult anti-inflammatory treatment.

claim: An alternative pathway to plasticity was not restored by anti-inflammatory treatment, but was evoked by exogenous adenosine receptor agonism.
